60 personal accounts. Thoughtfully selected excerpts.

About this project

Finding Resonance is an independent portfolio concept inspired by Come Near’s focus on connecting people with Jesus. It is not affiliated with Come Near or NDERF.

60 distinct accounts were individually reviewed for non-graphic, workplace-appropriate excerpt content. Eight explicitly name Jesus; 52 are clearly labeled thematic reflections. Connections to Jesus in those reflections are editorial invitations, not claims that the contributor encountered Him. They are personal reports, not verified accounts or clinical guidance. This screening covers the displayed excerpts, not the complete accounts on other websites.

The text comes only from NDERF lists that explicitly describe themselves as public domain. Quoted wording is preserved; headings and topic labels are editorial.

  • Accounts of God / a supreme being
  • Accounts of love
  • Accounts of life reviews

Source lists may contain other, more intense accounts. Your prompts and stories stay in this browser tab for review and clear when you reload. Matching uses local text retrieval and reviewed topic labels; it does not generate stories.
